newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire rebel leader says plans Kisangani visit.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebel leader says plans Kisangani visit.

text.p: Zaire rebel leader Laurent Kabila said he plans on Sunday to visit Kisangani, the country's third city captured by rebel forces on Saturday.
"I am planning to visit Kisangani tomorrow (Sunday) myself," Kabila told a news conference at rebel headquarters in Goma late on Saturday, adding he intended to fly.
Kabila, who said his troops took Kisangani at 1445 (1245 GMT) on Saturday, ruled out a ceasefire before talks with ailing Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko.

The fall of Kisangani, centre of the government's ineffective counter-offensive, deals a severe blow to Mobutu, who has rarely visited his country since undergoing surgery for prostrate cancer last August.
Zaire rebels have seized around one-fifth of Zaire since the start of their campaign last October.
